lines.text: Pizza or tacos? Fine by me.

data.define: Used to say you accept an idea.

example.text: Pizza or tacos? Fine by me.

misuse.text: Don't say 'fine by me' when you're upset.
misuse.why: People will think you truly don't mind.

data.l1_hook: Pizza oder Tacos, du entscheidest. ("fine by me")

native.tip: “fine by me” = Für mich in Ordnung. Beispiel: “Pizza or tacos? Fine by me.”
